info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Auto Insurance Quotes Discounts-v5-spec
info.description: The Auto Insurance Quotes Discounts API provides access to a comprehensive list of available discounts on auto insurance quotes. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about the various discounts they may qualify for, helping consumers make informed decisions and save on their insurance policies. It is particularly useful for insurance brokers, agents, and customers seeking to optimize their coverage costs. By leveraging this API, developers can enhance user experiences and promote cost-effective insurance solutions.

get.description: This operation fetches all applicable discounts that can be applied to quotes, enabling users to view potential savings before proceeding with their quote requests.
